name: Anna's Wedding Planning & Consulting
primary_cta: Find your package, then Request this date (call Nassau, copy the request, or her contact form)
brand_truth: One experienced planner in Nassau with published prices and the licence paperwork handled.
buyer: US, Canadian and international couples planning a Nassau beach or cruise-day wedding on a phone.

design.signature: Package finder with arrival mode and guest slider; licence checklist with progress ring

current_site_findings: Repetitive homepage slider with no clear next step
No email or WhatsApp, only a form
Cruise purser rule buried on licence page
20+ years and international couples hidden on About
pitch_line: Couples should see your prices and pick a package in one minute. Here they say how they arrive, how many come and how it should feel, and the right package comes up with its price and a request ready to send to you.
assumptions: Annamae Fox is the owner named Anna
Both phones current; WhatsApp number unknown
The 'feel' filter is derived only from package inclusions: live music = violin, saxophone, DJ or drummer; reception = a reception item.
No email or WhatsApp is published, so the request is called in, copied, or pasted into her contact form; add WhatsApp and email at launch.
Toll-free 877-524-9127 and 'since 1995' are from her homepage (scraped 2026-11-21).
notes: Gen 2 rebuild to the approved job spec (2026-11-21), refining the restored gen-1 composition. Removed for factory rules: key-information band, sticky blurred header with pill CTA, shared Reveal, mobile ActionBar (replaced by a dock shown after the finder).
